title: UHF X11: X11 Built for VisionOS and Apple Vision Pro
summary: UHF X11 is a port of the X11 window system specifically designed for VisionOS and Apple Vision Pro, enabling traditional X11 applications to run on Apple's spatial computing platform with potentially innovative 3D/spatial adaptations.
problem_solved: Brings legacy X11 window system compatibility to Apple's new Vision Pro spatial computing platform, solving the app availability gap for this emerging hardware.
why_valuable: Opens the door for thousands of existing X11 applications to potentially run on Vision Pro, accelerating the ecosystem development for spatial computing devices.
